title: Grilled Padron Peppers with Juicy Norwegian Sausage
description: A simple yet flavorful dish featuring grilled Padron peppers and juicy Norwegian sausage, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Norwegian sausage
ingredients.notes: you can also use other types of sausage, but Norwegian sausage is recommended for its juiciness

ingredients.name: Padron peppers
ingredients.notes: Padron peppers are mild and sweet, but some may be spicy, so be careful

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: to season the sausage and peppers

ingredients.name: pepper
ingredients.notes: to season the sausage and peppers

ingredients.name: grill
ingredients.notes: for grilling the peppers and sausage

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Brush the Padron peppers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the peppers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are slightly charred.
Grill the Norwegian sausage for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it is cooked through.
Serve the grilled sausage and peppers together, garnished with additional salt and pepper if desired.
